pr_title: Bluetooth: Host: Optimize hci buf alloc by calc actually require size
pr_body:
By calculating the actual space required instead of using the maximum space, 
for `ad_stream`, add two related APIs for save and restore status to calculate the total space.

Fixes #37710

Signed-off-by: Lingao Meng <menglingao@xiaomi.com>

issue_context.title: Bluetooth advert packet size is size of maximum packet not size of actual data
comments: Note: This would not be only advertising commands, but also other commands that are of variable length.
I wonder if "bug" is a proper label for this, as it more of an optimization request, is it not?

I think we can call it that. Actually I'm not sure what the impact on performance is here. If RPMsg is using shared memory then nothing should be "sent" in this case.
But it would be interested to know the impact of HCI over UART as well.

The reason I labelled this a bug was because we were getting advertising failed errors in our application when built for the nRF5340 but they worked fine on the nRF52840, our adverts aren't large in size and so we have to specifically add a workaround for the nRF5340 for this issue to support the large message
@thedjnK Enabling `CONFIG_BT_EXT_ADV=y` on hci_rpmsg would make the buffers equal size on both sides.
